title: A Ground-Truth Framework for Uncertainty Disentanglement with Posterior Risk
abstract: arXiv:2608.05995v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimates are critical in safety-sensitive applications. For such estimates to be useful in practice, it is crucial to understand the sources underlying a model's uncertainty, motivating the disentanglement of total uncertainty into epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty. Existing notions of uncertainty differ in the sources they capture and, consequently, in their definitions of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty, with no universally accepted definition. We define uncertainty through sample-conditional pointwise posterior risk, which is the expected loss of a predictor under the distribution of plausible ground-truth functions given the observed sample. This definition unifies probabilistic and risk-based concepts of uncertainty. To assess state-of-the-art uncertainty disentanglement methods, we develop a framework that directly compares their estimates against ground-truth uncertainty defined primarily by posteri

translated_title: 基于后验风险的不确定性解耦真值框架
translated_abstract: 可靠的不确定性估计在安全敏感的应用中至关重要。为了使这类估计在实践中发挥作用，理解模型不确定性背后的来源至关重要，这促使人们将总不确定性解耦为认知不确定性和偶然不确定性。现有的不确定性概念在其所捕捉的来源上各不相同，因此对偶然不确定性和认知不确定性的定义也不同，目前尚无普遍接受的定义。我们通过样本条件逐点后验风险来定义不确定性，即在给定观测样本的条件下，预测器在合理的真实函数分布下的期望损失。该定义统一了概率性和基于风险的不确定性概念。为了评估最先进的不确定性解耦方法，我们开发了一个框架，将其估计结果与主要由后验分布定义的真值不确定性进行直接比较。
tldr: 本文通过样本条件逐点后验风险定义不确定性，统一了概率性与基于风险的不确定性概念，并构建了一个真值框架用于直接评估最先进的不确定性解耦方法。
en_tdlr: This paper defines uncertainty via sample-conditional pointwise posterior risk, unifying probabilistic and risk-based uncertainty concepts, and builds a ground-truth framework to directly evaluate state-of-the-art uncertainty disentanglement methods.
